meta.title: AK Maison Biryani | South Indian Cuisine in Montreal
meta.description: AK Maison Biryani, authentic South Indian cuisine at 431 Boul. Henri Bourassa East, Montreal. Grand Opening November 11, 2026 at 11 AM.

common.logoHome: AK Maison Biryani, back to top

hero.intro: Discover the rich aromas, authentic spices, and unforgettable flavours of South Indian cuisine at AK Maison Biryani.

story.p1: AK Maison Biryani is a South Indian cuisine destination in the heart of Montreal, created around the dishes that define a generous Indian table: aromatic biryani, golden dosa, smoky tandoori and slow-simmered curries.
story.p2: Every plate is meant to be shared. Come with your family and friends, and enjoy the warmth of true Indian hospitality alongside flavours rich in spice and tradition.

chicken-dum-biryani.name: Chicken Dum Biryani
chicken-dum-biryani.description: Long-grain basmati and spiced chicken sealed in the pot and slow-cooked on dum, so every grain carries the aroma.

mutton-biryani.name: Mutton Biryani
mutton-biryani.description: Tender bone-in mutton folded through saffron rice, mint and crisp onions. A dish made for sharing and savouring.

masala-dosa.name: Crispy Masala Dosa
masala-dosa.description: A golden, paper-crisp dosa wrapped around spiced potato masala, served with sambar and fresh chutneys.

idli-sambar.name: Idli and Sambar
idli-sambar.description: Soft, steamed rice cakes with coconut chutney and a warm, tangy lentil sambar. A South Indian morning classic.

tandoori-chicken.name: Tandoori Chicken
tandoori-chicken.description: Marinated in yoghurt and bold spices, then fired until smoky, charred at the edges and juicy within.

chicken-65.name: Chicken 65
chicken-65.description: Fiery, crisp-fried chicken tossed with curry leaves, green chilli and garlic. The perfect starter.

chicken-curry.name: Traditional Chicken Curry
chicken-curry.description: A home-style gravy of roasted spices and onions, simmered slowly and made to be mopped up to the last drop.

mutton-curry.name: Mutton Curry
mutton-curry.description: Slow-cooked mutton in a deep, peppery masala, rich with whole spices and finished with fresh coriander.

south-indian-thali.name: South Indian Thali
south-indian-thali.description: A generous spread of rice, curries, poriyal and accompaniments, the way a South Indian table is meant to be enjoyed.

menu.intro: From aromatic biryanis to traditional South Indian favourites, discover a collection of authentic flavours crafted to make every meal memorable.

r1.title: Authentic South Indian Cuisine
r1.text: Biryani, dosa, tandoori and traditional meals, rooted in the flavours of South India.

r2.title: Rich Traditional Flavours
r2.text: Layered spices and slow cooking that give every dish its depth and aroma.

r3.title: Carefully Selected Ingredients
r3.text: Fresh herbs, whole spices and quality rice, chosen with care for every plate.

r4.title: Warm Indian Hospitality
r4.text: A welcome that treats every guest like family, from the first greeting to the last bite.
